sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners has only submitted that since a petrol pump is existing over the acquired land, therefore, notification is illegal.
However, we are of the opinion that the mere fact that a petrol pump or any other structure is existing over acquired land is not sufficient to render the notification illegal.
The affected person has right to claim compensation and rehabilitation as per provisions of the Act.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that their representation dated 29.11.2021 in which they have prayed for shifting of their petrol pump be directed to be decided.
4. Ms. Anjali Upadhya, learned counsel appearing on behalf of Greater Noida submits that the petitioners have right to approach the Authority under Section 64 of the Act.

5. Section 64 of the Act provides that any person interested who has not accepted the award may, by written application to the Collector, require that the matter be referred by the Collector for the determination of the Authority, inter alia, the rights of Rehabilitation and Resettlement under Chapters V and VI.
It further provides that in case, the reference is not made by the Collector within thirty days, the applicant gets a right to approach the Authority directly.
6. Accordingly, we leave it open to the petitioners to approach the Authority as provided under Section 64 of the Act.
In the event, any such application is filed before the Authority, the same shall be decided by it in accordance with law.
7. The petition stands disposed of accordingly.

Mukesh Kr.
